title: Console login by principal svc-deploy-prod from an unusual location
description: A successful console login was performed by IAM user svc-deploy-prod from a geolocation that does not match the user's established login pattern, without MFA.

title: API calls made from a known Tor exit node
description: IAM user svc-deploy-prod made multiple discovery-related API calls (GetCallerIdentity, ListUsers, ListRoles) from an IP address associated with the Tor anonymization network.

title: Anomalous privilege escalation behavior by svc-deploy-prod
description: IAM user svc-deploy-prod created a new access key for a separate, higher-privileged principal (svc-backup-admin) and attached the AdministratorAccess managed policy to itself. This combination of actions is inconsistent with the user's historical behavior.

title: CloudTrail logging was disabled
description: IAM user svc-deploy-prod called StopLogging on trail org-primary-trail, suspending delivery of management events for approximately 13 minutes before logging was re-enabled.

title: Anomalous S3 object access and cross-account transfer
description: A role assumed by svc-deploy-prod read multiple objects from a sensitive finance bucket (corp-finance-reports-2026) and wrote a bundled object to a bucket outside the organization's known inventory (data-relay-temp-8842), during the window CloudTrail logging was disabled.
